build_source_closure: Cargo.lock plus experiments/sys-landscape/Cargo.toml and this producer source; hashes above identify mutable source inputs without relying on a deletable target binary.
timing_fields: generation_ms, intervention_ms, and reconstruction_ms are one-run observations only; timing values are not byte-reproducible freeze data.

arms.fixed-normal-type-cone: Fixed normal rays; support multipliers 1+epsilon z_i with |z_i|<=1. epsilon is one quarter of measured minimum inactive incidence-slack fraction, halved until exact labeled incidence survives. Not quotient-transverse.
arms.o4-det-minus-haar: Haar det=-1 O(4) component: diag(-1,1,1,1) times Haar SO(4).
arms.sl4-bounded-weyl: Draw x1,x2,x3 iid Uniform[-log2,log2], set x4=-sum xi, reject if |x4|>log2, and sort the four values descending before L diag(e^xi) R for Haar SO(4) L,R. This is an explicit coordinate-dependent pushforward law in one bounded Weyl chamber, not Haar SL(4).
arms.so4-align-0: R=U1 A_theta U2 with independent Haar U(2); A_theta rotates the q-plane. theta=pi gives anti-symplectic diag(-1,-1,1,1) in SO(4).
arms.so4-align-pi: R=U1 A_theta U2 with independent Haar U(2); A_theta rotates the q-plane. theta=pi gives anti-symplectic diag(-1,-1,1,1) in SO(4).
arms.so4-align-pi-over-2: R=U1 A_theta U2 with independent Haar U(2); A_theta rotates the q-plane. theta=pi gives anti-symplectic diag(-1,-1,1,1) in SO(4).
arms.so4-haar: Haar SO(4) by real Gaussian QR and determinant correction.
arms.sp4-bounded-cartan: a,b iid Uniform[-log 2,log 2]; diag(e^a,e^b,e^-a,e^-b) U, U Haar U(2). Explicit bounded Cartan law, not Haar Sp(4).
arms.u2-haar: Haar U(2) by complex Gaussian QR in q,p block convention.

interpretation_boundary: Target-free geometry/reconstruction smoke only: it neither evaluates sys nor establishes a canonical metric, quotient-natural law, invariance of sys, or population effect.
